extracted.stage: Ongoing matrimonial proceedings with a hearing listed, running to settlement or trial
extracted.summary: A partner at Zielinski Partners enquires about £38,000 of funding for a client's representation in ongoing matrimonial proceedings where the matrimonial pot is around £385,500 and the other side controls the liquid assets, with a hearing on 12 October 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and the court dealing with the proceedings, details of the assets said to make up the £385,500 and how they are held, and the nature of the hearing listed for 12 October. It would also help to have your client's details for onboarding, a costs estimate or budget covering the £38,000 sought, and confirmation of any existing charges or competing claims over the assets in dispute. Once we have those materials a member of the team will review the file and come back to you. Nothing in this message should be taken as an indication that funding will be offered or on what terms.
